PhD Program in Computer Science: Admissions

The Department of Computer Science at Eastbrook University, United States, admits PhD students in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and cybersecurity.

Funding

All admitted PhD students receive full funding for five years, including a tuition waiver, a stipend of $3,200 per month, and health insurance coverage provided by the university.

Deadlines

Application deadline for Fall 2027 admission: December 1, 2026. Applications open on September 1, 2026.

Application fee

The application fee is $90 and is non-refundable. Fee waivers are available for eligible applicants, including McNair Scholars and applicants demonstrating financial hardship.

English proficiency

International applicants must submit official TOEFL iBT (minimum 90) or IELTS Academic (minimum 7.0) scores with the application by the application deadline. Applications without test scores will not be considered.

Applicants who completed a degree at an institution where English is the language of instruction are exempt from the English test requirement.

Required materials

  • Statement of purpose (maximum 1,000 words)
  • Three letters of recommendation
  • CV or résumé
  • Unofficial transcripts from all institutions attended
  • Writing sample (optional)

GRE scores are not required and will not be considered.
